title: Integrate Firecracker execution profile into SecurityExecutionEngine
purpose: Implement the Firecracker adapter profile as an optional high-risk SecurityExecution path with dependency probing and fail-closed reports.
scope: Add typed dependency probe and microVM execution report handling.
Bind Firecracker profile to CapabilityLease and SandboxProfile metadata.
Fail closed before EffectPrepared when dependencies are missing.
Keep optional integration smoke separate from baseline local-only tests.
implementation_steps: Add Firecracker dependency probe model and fixture tests.
Integrate probe result into SecurityExecution prepare path.
Add fail-closed explanation and audit metadata for missing dependencies.
Add optional smoke command documentation for environments with Firecracker.
acceptance_criteria: Missing Firecracker dependencies produce FailedClosed before EffectPrepared.
CapabilityLease is the only profile authority.
Planner hints cannot widen network or filesystem access.
Audit projection explains profile selection and failure reason.
failure_modes: Dependency probing happens after preparing an effect.
VM network allowlist is inferred from planner text.

blocked_until: Firecracker fail-closed tests and evidence pass.
